title: Atari Arcade
card: A newborn brain learns Atari games in your browser by watching a teacher, then plays alone. In Freeway it beats its teacher.
tagline: Born knowing nothing, it learns a game by watching, then plays alone
kicker: LEARNS DURING ITS LIFE, FROM A TEACHER
feature: A newborn brain learns each game in your browser: it watches a teacher for about a minute, then takes the controls and plays in real time, the game never waiting for it. In Freeway it beats its teacher; in Atlantis it ties.
howTo: Watch the agreement with the teacher climb until the brain takes the controls. Compare its scores with the teacher's in each row's header: the badge reads legend above the teacher. Speed slows the games. Rest on a ? to learn more.
